title: Finite completed modules are limits of their canonical affine quotient cones
statement: Let A be Noetherian, I an ideal, B=AdicCompletion I A, and J the ideal sheaf associated with I under ΓSpecIso. For each finite B-module N the explicit cone of def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-affine-quotient-cone is limiting in A-modules. Moreover its projection at op n sends r*x to a times the projection of x whenever evalₐ I (n+1) r is the residue of a in A/I^(n+1). No inverse functor or candidate comparison is part of this statement.

proof.text: Set B=AdicCompletion I A and M=N restricted to A. B is Noetherian and complete for I.map(algebraMap). Apply finite_module_complete_over_complete_noetherian to N.property, then IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff to obtain IsAdicComplete I M. No choice of new module data is made.

Apply the affine projection comparison at each n+1 to the explicitly constructed cone c. The first isomorphism theorem gives e_n:M/I^(n+1)M ≃ D_n with e_n([x])=c.π_n(x). Surjectivity of c.π_(n+1) and c.w identify the transitions through these e_n with factorPow. For each cone s set f_n=e_n.symm composed with s.π_n. Its successor compatibility follows from s.w. Apply IsAdicComplete.StrictMono.lift for a(n)=n+1. The mk_lift formula and injectivity of e_n.symm prove the cone equations; eq_lift proves uniqueness. This constructs IsLimit c, as in the private proved helper isLimit_of_complete_quotient_projections.

If evalₐ r is the residue of a, evaluation kills r-algebraMap a. The completion kernel formula puts this difference in I^(n+1) times B. Induction on ideal-module products and smul_assoc puts its product with x in I^(n+1)M. The affine projection kernel formula kills this product. Expand sub_smul and map_sub; A-linearity of the projection gives π(r*x)=a*π(x).

theorem coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientCone_complete
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (N : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun N : ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A) ↦ Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N)) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientCone A I J N.obj)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : AdicCompletion I A) (a : A) (x : N.obj),
      AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1) r = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)) a →
      (coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientCone A I J N.obj).π.app (op n) (r • x) =
        a • (coherentFormalModules_affine_quotientCone A I J N.obj).π.app (op n) x)
